scenes.title: Hook
scenes.visual: Text scene on paper white: slides, a handout and a notes file drop onto the page; a forgetting curve draws itself and falls.

cues.text: You have the slides, the handouts, and a folder of notes.
cues.say: You have the slides, the handouts, and a folder of notes.

cues.text: You reread them before the exam, and a week later most of it is gone.
cues.say: You reread them before the exam. And a week later, most of it is gone.

cues.text: Being tested on something does more for memory than reading it again.
cues.say: Being tested on something does more for memory than reading it again.

scenes.title: What MDlearn is
scenes.visual: Title card: the MDlearn mark, name and one line. Then the Studio first page, with its three steps.

cues.text: MDlearn turns your class files, or just a topic, into better notes you can study.
cues.say: M D learn turns your class files, or just a topic, into better notes you can study.

cues.text: An AI you already use writes them, a strict compiler checks them,
cues.say: An AI you already use writes them. A strict compiler checks them.

cues.text: and spaced repetition brings each idea back just before you'd forget it.
cues.say: And spaced repetition brings each idea back, just before you'd forget it.

cues.text: It runs on your computer, with no account. Your notes are plain Markdown files.
cues.say: It runs on your computer, with no account. Your notes are plain markdown files.

scenes.title: Make a course
scenes.visual: Live Studio: Make a course, type the topic, add Lecture 3.pptx and Handout 2.docx, What was read, the course form, My coding assistant, the notes appearing in the folder.

cues.text: Say what you want to learn, and add any PDFs, slides or Word files.
cues.say: Say what you want to learn, and add any P D Fs, slides, or Word files.

cues.text: MDlearn shows what it could read from each one.
cues.say: M D learn shows what it could read from each one.

cues.text: Choose the kind of course you want,
cues.say: Choose the kind of course you want,

cues.text: and who writes it: Claude from here, your coding assistant, or a chat.
cues.say: and who writes it. Claude from here, your coding assistant, or a chat.

cues.text: The notes appear as they are written.
cues.say: The notes appear as they are written.

scenes.title: Under the hood
scenes.visual: Animated diagram: files or a topic, your AI, Markdown notes, the @mdlearn/core compiler (parse, validate, lint), then Studio, the CLI and the MCP server, FSRS and progress.json. A terminal panel shows real mdlearn lint output.

cues.text: Under the hood, every note is Markdown, with blocks for questions and plots.
cues.say: Under the hood, every note is markdown, with blocks for questions and plots.

cues.text: The compiler checks every block. A broken question is locked, never shown.
cues.say: The compiler checks every block. A broken question is locked, never shown.

cues.text: One core runs the app, the command line, and an MCP server for AI assistants.
cues.say: One core runs the app, the command line, and an M C P server for AI assistants.

cues.text: Your answers feed an FSRS scheduler, kept in one file on your disk.
cues.say: Your answers feed an F S R S scheduler, kept in one file on your disk.

scenes.title: Features in action
scenes.visual: Live Studio: the Carnot note with its formula term by term and a plot whose slider moves; the four-step animation; a study card answered, 'were you sure?', feedback; Today.

cues.text: Formulas are explained term by term, in colour.
cues.say: Formulas are explained term by term, in colour.

cues.text: Plots have sliders, and derivations play one step at a time.
cues.say: Plots have sliders, and derivations play one step at a time.

cues.text: When you study, you answer, then say whether you were sure, so lucky guesses come back sooner.
cues.say: When you study, you answer, then say whether you were sure. So lucky guesses come back sooner.

cues.text: Today plans a short session for each day.
cues.say: Today plans a short session for each day.

scenes.title: Make it yours
scenes.visual: Live Studio on the Carnot note: the reading font switched to Easy to read and made bigger; a phrase highlighted in yellow; a passage explained by the local AI beside the text; Pixel, the companion, asked a question in the sidebar and answering with its source.

cues.text: Make it yours: pick the reading font and size,
cues.say: Make it yours: pick the reading font and size,

cues.text: and highlight in colour, right in the text.
cues.say: and highlight in colour, right in the text.

cues.text: Select a passage, and an AI explains it beside the text.
cues.say: Select a passage, and an AI explains it beside the text.

cues.text: And Pixel, your study companion, grows as you study and answers your questions, with sources.
cues.say: And Pixel, your study companion, grows as you study, and answers your questions, with sources.

scenes.title: Get started
scenes.visual: End card: npx mdlearn studio in a terminal line, the desktop downloads, github.com/MD-Learn/MD-Learn, MIT.

cues.text: Download the desktop app, or run npx mdlearn studio.
cues.say: Download the desktop app, or run, N P X, M D learn studio.

cues.text: It's open source, under the MIT licence. Find it on GitHub; issues and pull requests are welcome.
cues.say: It's open source, under the M I T licence. Find it on GitHub. Issues and pull requests are welcome.
